context:
Goal: orders reach the ledger without a manual CSV export.
Problem (goal): draft PR #154 builds a nightly Worker cron that signs in to TCGplayer with a stored cookie. On 2026-10-28 that cookie was measured expiring after 1 hour, so the cron can't run on its own. An extension plan reuses #154's parser and merge code without the cron. It has had no answer since 10-28, and the question was never on this page.
Stale record: decision sync-revamp-cloudflare line 46 rules the cookie cron (your 10-27 20:19 CDT "Yea let's do A"). It rests on the cookie lasting; that was measured false on 10-28. The outcome it protected, orders arriving with no export, has nothing protecting it now.
Based on (measured): handoff 0bb58e2e premises P3 and P4, BuyerRevalidationKey expired after 1 h; sign-in loads hCaptcha.
Based on (read): main has no worker/orders.mjs or mergeIntoStore. sync-revamp-cloudflare lines 43-47 and csv-import-stays-web line 13 still describe the cookie cron.
Departs from: main plans a cookie cron (orders-job-unbuilt) — option a replaces it with a browser extension plus a Worker POST /orders.
After the answer: on a or b, the branch b/orders-cron is archived and #154 closed, the three records are rewritten, and the TCG_COOKIE Worker secret and the Keychain item mailaudit-tcg-cookie are removed. Whether the secret is still set is unchecked.
home: lane orders-extension (local_ebb91723-0535-414a-a6a6-88fd84220244), started 15:02 CST 2026-11-08; it rewrites sync-revamp-cloudflare, orders-job-unbuilt and csv-import-stays-web

options.gain: Orders arrive with no CSV step, built on #154's parser.
options.how: A browser extension reads your TCGplayer orders while you are signed in and sends them to the Worker, reusing #154's parser and merge code.
options.label: Go on the extension plan
options.lose: Two new lanes, a server lane and an extension lane, and a browser extension to keep up.

options.gain: No new parts to keep up.
options.how: Orders keep coming in through the CSV export, as today.
options.label: Stay on the OrderWand CSV import
options.lose: Every order still needs a manual export.

options.how: The nightly Worker cron signs in with the stored cookie.
options.label: Keep the cookie cron
options.lose: It stops working an hour after each sign-in.

ref: draft PR #154 (nightly orders cron, branch b/orders-cron); handoff 0bb58e2e premises P3 and P4; decision csv-import-stays-web
title: Orders without a CSV export: go on the browser-extension plan?
why: Only option a needs no manual step and actually works.
